purpose: NORTH WALK 3-frame REPLACEMENT (walk_north_1/2/3.png) — new source art, same landmark-matching methodology as the previous north walk batches. north_idle/north_attack/north_defense are explicitly NOT touched.
processing: Non-generative only -- no AI redraw/regeneration/mirroring. All 3 sources carried the SAME white-background-composite alpha bug as earlier batches (DARK PHASE, the first south-walk batch): bucketing edge pixels (alpha in (3,250)) by alpha value showed mean brightness falling from ~226-228 (alpha 3-30) down to ~58-80 (alpha 200-250) -- climbing toward white as alpha drops is the signature of a flatten-over-white-then-rethreshold pipeline that never un-premultiplied the RGB. Fixed via the same deterministic 'un-premultiply against a known white background' formula used previously: for every pixel with alpha>0, true color F = clip((RGB - (1-alpha/255)*255) / (alpha/255), 0, 255); alpha kept as-is; alpha==0 zeroed. Re-bucketed after the fix: brightness roughly flat (~24-67) across the mid/high alpha range instead of climbing toward white; confirmed visually with a dark-background composite (no fringe on the wing feather edges). The unblended intermediates were not persisted separately -- only the original raw sources and the final composited walk_north_N.png files are kept, matching how the earlier south-walk unblend batch documented (not stored) its own intermediate.
landmark_method: head_top_y/head_center_x found by scanning alpha>10 within columns x < ~50-55% of native image width (excludes the wing, which sits right-of-center/back in this pose) for the topmost contiguous opaque row and that row's horizontal center; verified visually per-frame by marking the computed point and confirming it lands on the crown of the head. feet_bottom_y is the single lowest opaque row overall.

targets_reused_from_existing_shipped_ass.note: Re-measured directly on the CURRENTLY SHIPPED walk_north_1/2/3.png (rather than trusting the older north_walk2_build_meta.json alone) to confirm the live target: all 3 shipped frames land within 1px of head_top_y=182-183/head_center_x=336.5-337/feet_bottom_y=898-899, matching that older meta's own target_head_top_y=182/target_head_center_x=337.0/target_feet_bottom_y=900/target_body_span=718 (originally derived from north_idle.png) almost exactly -- so this batch reuses those same constants to preserve the pre-replacement on-canvas size.

placement_formula: paste_x = round(TARGET_HEAD_CENTER_X - head_center_x*scale); paste_y = round(TARGET_FEET_BOTTOM_Y - feet_bottom_y*scale); pasted onto a fresh transparent 700x920 canvas.
clip_note: frame2's placement math wanted paste_y=-4 (4px above the canvas top) -- cropped the resized image's top 4px (a wing feather tip only, imperceptible on a 920px-tall canvas) before pasting at paste_y=0 rather than shrinking the body match. frame1/frame3 needed no clipping.

verification_on_final_canvas.method: Re-measured head_top_y/head_center_x on the FINAL 700x920 canvas (x<385px column exclusion, matching how the live target itself was re-verified) and feet_bottom_y as the overall lowest opaque row.
verification_on_final_canvas.note: All three land within 1px of TARGET and of each other on every axis -- no per-frame jump in size, position, or foot anchor.

in_game_scale: walk_north_1/2/3 continue to use the boss's normal uniform BOSS_DRAW_H/BOSS_CANVAS_W/H rendering plus the existing small NORTH_BOUNCE_AMPLITUDE draw-time bounce -- neither was touched by this batch.
animation_wiring: bossFrameName()'s NORTH branch is UNCHANGED by this batch -- still the plain 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 1 wrap-around via `Math.floor(now / WALK_FRAME_PERIOD_MS) % 3`, same WALK_FRAME_PERIOD_MS as before. Only the 3 image files were replaced.
not_touched: north_idle.png, attack_north.png, defense_north.png are unmodified by this batch.
